title: ProForm Dashboard — Visual Consistency + Ring Logic Fixes

stories.title: Ring refresh after workout add/update in diary
stories.description: When a user adds or edits a workout in /diary while the dashboard is in the same session, the WeeklyPlanCard ring does not update its minutes/percentage because AthleteDash.useEffect only fires once on mount. Fix by dispatching a custom DOM event from diary and listening for it in dashboard to re-fetch weekly data.
acceptanceCriteria: diary/page.tsx handleCreated dispatches window CustomEvent 'proform:workout-added' after onCreated(workout) call
diary/page.tsx handleUpdated dispatches window CustomEvent 'proform:workout-added' after updating workout (duration change also affects weekly total)
dashboard/page.tsx AthleteDash has a separate loadWeekly() function that re-fetches only workouts for the current week
dashboard/page.tsx AthleteDash useEffect adds event listener for 'proform:workout-added' that calls loadWeekly()
Event listener is cleaned up in useEffect return (removeEventListener)
TypeScript compiles with no new errors on dashboard/page.tsx and diary/page.tsx

stories.title: Dashboard TrainingWidget sport-specific colors
stories.description: TrainingWidget hardcodes orange icons for past workouts and blue icons for upcoming events regardless of sport type. Calendar and Diary use ACTIVITY_CONFIG with sport-specific bg/border/text colors. Dashboard should match this system.
acceptanceCriteria: dashboard/page.tsx defines ACTIVITY_CONFIG matching diary/page.tsx (Бег=blue, Велоспорт=orange, Плавание=cyan, Силовые=purple, Ходьба=green, Другое=slate)
Past workout rows use ACTIVITY_CONFIG[w.activity_type] colors for icon container bg and icon color
Upcoming event rows use ACTIVITY_CONFIG[ev.activity_type] colors for icon container bg and icon color
getActivityIcon() is updated or replaced to use ACTIVITY_CONFIG and return both icon name and colors
TypeScript compiles with no new errors on dashboard/page.tsx

stories.title: WeeklyPlanCard: handle no-goal state correctly
stories.description: When weekly_training_hours is null (new user hasn't set a goal), the fallback is 10h which shows misleading progress. Should show a dedicated 'no goal set' UI with a link to settings.
acceptanceCriteria: When athletes.weekly_training_hours is null/0, WeeklyPlanCard shows a 'goal not set' empty state instead of fake progress
The empty state includes a link/button to /settings to set the weekly goal
When weekly_training_hours IS set (> 0), the ring/card works as before
No hardcoded fallback of 10 when the athlete has no goal set
TypeScript compiles with no new errors

stories.title: Align dashboard card visual style with Metronic design tokens
stories.description: Calendar page uses SurfaceFrame (rounded-[28px], richer shadows). Diary uses rounded-xl with structured headers matching Metronic patterns. Dashboard cards use rounded-xl but with simpler styling. The WeeklyPlanCard, TrainingWidget and profile section should visually align with the overall design language.
acceptanceCriteria: WeeklyPlanCard uses rounded-2xl (or rounded-[20px]) with consistent border/shadow matching diary card style
TrainingWidget header section label uses the same uppercase tracking text style as calendar/diary section labels
Compact profile header has subtle visual separation (bg-card, rounded, border) so it doesn't float in empty space
All metric stat boxes inside WeeklyPlanCard use consistent Metronic-style border/bg tokens (no raw hex colors for backgrounds)
TypeScript compiles with no new errors
